description: Find, explain, and keep an eye on household bills without a HomeOps account or storage

defaultPrompt: Show me my latest electricity bill.
Check weekly for new bills from this provider.
interface.longDescription: You know the bill arrived. You just can't find it. Ask instead. “How much is my electricity bill?” HomeOps finds the email, opens the actual PDF where there is one, and tells you the amount, the period, and when it's due. When something isn't stated — no due date, an unclear figure — it says so, rather than filling the gap with a guess. It can remind you before a bill falls due, and check each week for the next one from a provider you name. Those checks belong to you: they live in ChatGPT, and you can pause or delete them whenever you like. And here's the part most apps can't say. HomeOps has no account, no database, no server. It isn't that we promise not to keep your bills — there is nowhere for them to go.

name: homeops-public
